caption: The drawing depicts an interior wall with a rectangular section of faded pink paint bordered by a patterned, lace-like design in pale gray and black. The pink section has worn or damaged areas, especially along the lower edge, revealing irregular patches of an underlying surface. Each corner of the pink panel features a decorative fan motif in black and gold. Above the pink section, a horizontal border displays a repeating pattern of red leaves or flowers with black dots and gray vine-like lines. The drawing shows two doors or panels painted in a dull greenish-gray shade. On the left, a mantle or shelf projects from the wall, holding a red circular object and a blue rectangular item, with part of a black chain or hook visible hanging below. The overall composition has an architectural focus with a limited color palette dominated by pale pink, gray, white, red, black, and touches of gold and blue.
title: Stencilled Wall
